sections.title: Vehicle and hire reference
sections.note: Attach your reviewed terms and insurance wording. This schedule alone is not a complete rental agreement. Record delivery of the signed agreement separately.
sections.sql: SELECT b.ref,v.plate,v.model FROM bookings b JOIN vehicles v ON v.id=b.vehicle_id WHERE b.id=$1

sections.title: Hirer contact
sections.sql: SELECT d.name,d.address,d.phone,d.dob FROM bookings b JOIN drivers d ON d.id=b.driver_id WHERE b.id=$1

sections.title: Licence evidence
sections.sql: SELECT d.licence_number,d.licence_jurisdiction,d.licence_expires FROM bookings b JOIN drivers d ON d.id=b.driver_id WHERE b.id=$1

sections.title: Additional authorised drivers
sections.sql: SELECT d.name,d.address,d.licence_number,d.licence_jurisdiction,d.licence_expires FROM booking_drivers bd JOIN drivers d ON d.id=bd.driver_id WHERE bd.booking_id=$1

name: return-condition
title: Vehicle return condition record
for_each: SELECT id,ref FROM bookings WHERE status='returned'

sections.title: Return record
sections.sql: SELECT b.ref,v.plate,b.returned_at,b.km_out,b.km_in,b.fuel_out,b.fuel_in FROM bookings b JOIN vehicles v ON v.id=b.vehicle_id WHERE b.id=$1

sections.title: Desk notes
sections.sql: SELECT created_at,body FROM notes WHERE booking_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at

name: balance-statement
title: Rental balance statement draft
for_each: SELECT id,ref FROM bookings WHERE status!='cancelled'

sections.title: Balance
sections.note: Not a tax invoice. Verify charges against the agreed terms before sending.

sections.title: Notice details
sections.note: Internal worksheet. Use the issuing authority form for any nomination or declaration. No nomination or payment is sent.

sections.title: Recorded vehicle custody
sections.sql: SELECT b.ref,v.plate,b.checkout_at,b.returned_at FROM infringements i JOIN bookings b ON b.id=i.booking_id JOIN vehicles v ON v.id=b.vehicle_id WHERE i.id=$1

sections.title: Primary hirer, not proof of who drove
sections.sql: SELECT d.name,d.address,d.licence_number FROM infringements i JOIN bookings b ON b.id=i.booking_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id=b.driver_id WHERE i.id=$1
